semantics.compiled: Strict literal calls anywhere in concrete/inherited model source. Calls may occur in constructors, registerPoses or named-animation methods; source lines retained for conditional/lazy review. Framework helper definitions are not themselves concrete bone requirements.
semantics.json_override: JSON posers registered after compiled ones override same IDs; only apply this map when effective poser remains inbuilt.
semantics.json_root: Selected JSON root is named __root in relevantPartsByName; only its descendants retain geometry names. Explicit rootBone absent from wrapper children falls back to filename child, else first non-locator child.
semantics.compiled_root: Compiled factories receive outer baked ModelPart. registerChildWithAllChildren usually requires named top-level root. getPart/registerChild calls derive actual mandatory parts; inspect dynamic_calls for nonliteral names.
semantics.bare_look: Bare look uses nullable head_ai/head fallback and is not a mandatory-bone query.
semantics.query_failures: Factory lookups are strict, but JsonPose catches some failures in idle-animation string resolution. String quirks and lazy named animations/transitions can still propagate exceptions.
semantics.phase_classification: Method brace ranges identify registerPoses vs named methods; eager initializer requirements exclude source prefixes containing if/when/lazy or lambda arrows. Conditional classification is conservative, not complete Kotlin control-flow analysis. All strict call locations remain available in calls.
semantics.framework_superclasses: PokemonPosableModel and PosablePokeBallModel contain no strict concrete part lookup calls. PosableModel only declares generic helper implementations and is deliberately excluded from concrete requirements. Other resolvable inherited class sources were scanned recursively.
